name: sherpa
description: Composable /frame, /shape, /implement skills — one per layer (macro, shape, build) — with adversarial review at every boundary. The user composes the workflow; opt-in /persist for state.

interface.shortDescription: Composable frame, shape, and implement layers
interface.longDescription: Adds opt-in Sherpa skills — /frame (scout, bind a problem contract), /shape (fan out directions, pick one, then plan the steps), /implement (build with per-step review) — that the user composes into a workflow. Nothing persists unless you call /persist.
defaultPrompt: Use /frame to shape this fuzzy task.
Use /shape to fan out competing directions, pick one, and plan the steps.
Use /implement to build the approved plan.
